findings.observation: Product credit appeared on an early page.
findings.rule: Keep the two product credits for the last page and retain the independent page numbers and author credit.
findings.reason: Makes credits a book-level decision while keeping page identification.

findings.observation: A pointing gesture appeared to aim at a balloon, and an eye-level clause stopped an angled shot.
findings.rule: Check the gesture and balloon together. Validate camera height and direction in the actual page mode before assembling the prompt.
findings.reason: The reader and the application both need an unambiguous direction.

findings.observation: Repair of one hand risked changing the good supporting hand and produced incompatible visible pan surfaces.
findings.rule: Specify the changed and retained traits. Trace the grip, attachment and tool through one viewpoint.
findings.reason: Preserves the good pose and keeps the action physically readable.

findings.observation: The action differed from the implied wording and the adopted framing used the pan rather than the sleeve.
findings.rule: Read decisive action without lettering. Record intended and observed effects when the manga is a technique sample.
findings.reason: Shows what the final sample demonstrates.
